text: FIVS 101 Introduction to Academic Success in Forensic and Investigative Sciences Credits: Credit 1. 1 Lecture Hour. Overview: 1 Lecture Hour. text: FIVS 316 Biotechnology and Forensics Credits: 4. 3 Lecture Hours. 3 Lab Hours. Overview: 3 Lecture Hours. 3 Lab Hours.
